description: THE MODULATOR SPACE + EMERGENCE-BY-REGION (block 207000) -- re-derives Bach/Dorner PSI/MicroPsi: emotions are REGIONS in a small space of global cognitive modulators, the modulators SET by the 207000 drive system. Six integer modulator update rules on a ModulatorState (one per EmotionHub): valence = Sum(pleasure)-Sum(displeasure)-Sum(urge) over active drives (sign = circumplex x); arousal = Sum_d(arousal_contrib) (a threat drive contributes its 196000-decayed precision, so fear=low/anxiety=high fall out of the half-life; an un-appraised leading spike is the raw residual -- pre-appraisal orienting) + a pre-registered 3-way band; resolution = base + urgency(leading) - k*arousal (inverse of arousal, NEW global scope of the 198000 LOD atom); sel_threshold = weight*urgency(leading)/SCALE - k*(1-competence) (resist-switch bonus, NEW half of the 202000 commit-net); securing = uncertainty + (1-competence) - k*importance (outward vigilance, NEW); competence = running accumulator seeded from the 202000 learning-progress (NEW). Then ~14 REGION predicates read the modulator vector + the leading drive's object/directedness and set action_tendency -- these REPLACE 204000's 11 authored per-emotion appraisals. Directedness (fear/anger/grief at an object vs joy/bliss/angst undirected) comes from the bound drive, not the modulators alone. Blends bliss (pos/low-arousal/high-resolution), angst (undirected anxiety), grief (directed sadness) fall out as DISTINCT regions with no new modulator/atom/drive. Integer-native, NO Rust, NO new Term (Sum/Neighbours aggregate the drives). OFF by default: every rule guards on ModulatorState.enabled the measure adapter creates only on opt-in; absent it every existing path is byte-identical. The parameter drop: 11 authored appraisal rules -> 6 modulator updates + ~14 region predicates over shared axes, blends free.

microtheory.name: modulators
microtheory.description: Modulators are global configuration parameters of cognition set by the urge configuration; they are NOT emotions -- affects are REGIONS within the modulator space. valence/arousal/resolution/selection-threshold/securing/competence, computed from the drive system; named emotions and their directed/undirected blends are co-occurrence regions read together with the leading drive's object.
